# Bengaluru Skill Summit 2026

> The Bengaluru Skill Summit is Karnataka's flagship skilling platform, uniting industry, government, academia, and youth to co-create a future-ready workforce. The second edition — themed "Workforce 2030: Scale, Systems, Synergy" — takes place 3–5 November 2026 at The Lalit Ashok, Bengaluru. It is organized by Trescon Events Organizing Ltd in association with the Government of Karnataka and Kaushalya Karnataka.

Source page: https://bengaluruskillsummit.com/
Last modified: 2026-09-08

---

## Theme and Overview

**Workforce 2030: Scale, Systems, Synergy**

Built on the success of the inaugural Bengaluru Skill Summit 2025, the second edition returns in 2026 with deeper engagement, broader participation, and a sharper focus on workforce outcomes at a significantly larger scale.

## The Scale of Impact (2025 edition)

- 6,500 — Footfall
- 150 — Speakers
- 100 — Partners
- 50 — Exhibitors

## What's Evolving in 2026

What to expect at the 2nd edition:

- Stronger alignment between policy, industry, and institutions
- Expanded focus on future-ready skills and workforce transformation
- Deeper industry participation and outcome-driven conversations
- Enhanced youth and innovation engagement

- **Policymakers & Government Leaders** — Driving skills policy, workforce planning, and ecosystem collaboration
- **Industry & Employers** — Shaping talent pipelines, future skills demand, and workforce readiness
- **Academia & Training Institutions** — Aligning education and skilling with industry and policy priorities
- **Youth & Workforce Entrants** — Understanding emerging opportunities and future career pathways

## Summit Thematic Tracks

- **Emerging Skills** — Preparing for green jobs, AI, Industry 4.0, and the digital economy, among other growth sectors
- **Skills for All** — Advancing inclusion across women, youth, informal workers, and the gig economy
- **Innovation** — Showcasing global and local best practices and ecosystem innovations in skilling
- **Global Skills** — Positioning Karnataka's workforce for global employability and mobility

## Why Karnataka? Why Bengaluru Skill Summit?

Karnataka has emerged as one of India's most advanced skill and talent ecosystems driven by a clear policy vision, strong institutional capacity, and deep industry participation. The Bengaluru Skill Summit serves as the platform where this vision translates into dialogue, collaboration, and outcomes.

- **India's Skill & Knowledge Capital** — Karnataka is home to one of the country's largest formally skilled workforces, supported by a strong network of ITIs, polytechnics, universities, and industry-aligned training institutions.
- **Technology, Innovation, and Talent Hub** — With a significant share of India's technology exports, startups, unicorns, and Global Capability Centres, Karnataka continues to shape how skills align with emerging technologies and global workforce demand.
- **Manufacturing, Bioeconomy, and Advanced Sectors** — From aerospace and defence to electronics, bioeconomy, and advanced manufacturing, Karnataka's growth sectors are driving the need for future-ready, industry-relevant skills at scale.
- **Inclusive and Outcome-Oriented Skill Development** — Karnataka's approach to skilling emphasises inclusion, regional balance, and employability, ensuring participation across rural and urban regions, with strong focus on women and youth.
- **A Future-Ready Skill Ecosystem** — With a sustained focus on AI, Industry 4.0, green jobs, and emerging sectors, Karnataka's skill ecosystem is geared towards supporting long-term workforce transformation and job creation.

Bengaluru Skill Summit brings this ecosystem together — policy leaders, industry, institutions, and youth — to align vision with execution and scale impact year after year.

## Skillathon 2025 — Young Minds Powering Tomorrow's Skills

As part of the Bengaluru Skill Summit 2025, Skillathon is a national competition challenging college teams to design bold solutions for the future of skills, education, and jobs. Round 1 evaluations are complete, and shortlisted teams advanced to the Grand Finale on 5 November 2025 at Bengaluru Skill Summit.

Skillathon 2025 in Numbers:

- 250 — Teams Applied
- 900 — Students Participated
- 200 — Institutions Represented
- 15 — Teams Shortlisted for Finals

More: https://bengaluruskillsummit.com/skillathon-2025/

### Skillathon 2025 Jury Leaders

- **Dr. Prasant Misra** — Chair Elect, IEEE Bangalore Section
- **Dr. Sneha Thapliyal** — Professor, National Law School of India University
- **Manjula V** — IAS (R), Former Additional Chief Secretary to the Government of Karnataka
- **Monica Datta** — Head, Tech4PositiveFutures, Capgemini CSR
- **Sonali Keshwa Murti** — Program Director, Melton Foundation

## Kaushalya Karnataka Awards 2025 — Recognising Excellence in Skilling

The Kaushalya Karnataka Awards celebrate outstanding contributions to skill development across Karnataka, recognising institutions, trainers, trainees, industries, and districts for their innovation, performance, and impact. These awards are a prestigious feature of Bengaluru Skill Summit, highlighting leadership in workforce development.

More: https://bengaluruskillsummit.com/kaushalya-karnataka-awards-2025/

## Activation Ecosystem 2026

- **First-hand access to Karnataka's vision** — Experience the State's blueprint for future-ready talent.
- **Insights into future skill demand** — Understand how emerging technologies, AI, Industry 4.0, and green jobs will reshape the workforce of tomorrow.
- **Influence & Collaborate** — Be part of policy discussions, roundtables, and industry dialogues shaping India's skills and employment agenda.
- **Best Practices in Public–Private Collaboration** — See how industry and government align training with jobs.
- **Global Mobility Opportunities** — Explore pathways for international recognition, mutual agreements, and overseas employment linkages.
- **Inclusive Growth in Action** — See how Karnataka is making skilling aspirational and accessible for women, rural youth, gig workers, and marginalised communities.
- **Unparalleled networking** — Connect with 4,500+ participants, including policymakers, corporate leaders, multilateral agencies, academia, NGOs, and international agencies.
- **Skill Expo & Youth Zone** — Experience live showcases, innovations, and career opportunities that highlight the future of work.
- **Year-Round Platforms for Engagement** — Extend learning and partnerships beyond the summit.

## Voices from Bengaluru Skill Summit 2025 (selected testimonials)

- **Subroto Bagchi**, Co-Founder of Mindtree, Former Chairman of Odisha Skill Development Authority — "Skill development is not about employment. It's about human transformation."
- **Ravi Venkatesan**, Chairman, Global Energy Alliance; Former Chairman, Microsoft India & Bank of Baroda — On AI reshaping the job market and opening a potential golden age of work.
- **B V R Subrahmanyam, IAS (R)**, Chief Executive Officer, NITI Aayog — On skilling being treated as integral to education rather than an extracurricular activity.
- **Dr. Phillipp Ackermann**, Ambassador, Federal Republic of Germany to India — On Germany's commitment as Country Partner to high-quality skilling and fair pathways for Indian talent.
- **Denise Eichhorn**, Head of Skilled Migration, Indo-German Chamber of Commerce — On vocational cooperation shaping India's skilling landscape.
- **Dr. Gayathri Vasudevan**, Chief Impact Officer, Sambhav Foundation — On building the right competencies for industry to thrive.
- **Deepak Prabhu Matti**, Chief Executive Officer, Cognizant Foundation — On collaboration strengthening Karnataka's skilling ecosystem.

(Additional testimonials from delegates, exhibitors, and students are featured on the site.)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**When is the Bengaluru Skill Summit 2026?**
The Bengaluru Skill Summit 2026 will be held from 3 to 5 November 2026.

**Where will the summit take place?**
The Lalit Ashok, Bangalore.

**How can I participate or register?**
Visit the homepage, which has direct links for both summit registration and general enquiries.

**Who should attend the summit?**
The summit is designed for policymakers, industry leaders, employers, academia and training institutions, youth, and ecosystem partners engaged in skills development and workforce transformation.

**What will be the focus areas for the 2026 edition?**
The 2026 edition will focus on future-ready skills, workforce transformation, industry participation, policy alignment, and youth engagement. Detailed tracks and sessions will be announced closer to the event.

**How can organisations partner with the summit?**
Submit an enquiry on the website or connect with the team directly.
